Positive integer dimensions are faithfully encoded by n,m:ℕ with 1≤n and 1≤m; neither dimension is fixed or omitted, and Fin n sums include every spatial coordinate. The field is ℝ throughout. H003 constrains the same q:V m used in H006, and H004 constrains the actual values of u. H005 is ∀x ∀t>0 ∃a:ℝ with precisely dt(dt u)−lap u=a•u; it assumes neither a regular scalar field nor the derived explicit wave-map equation. H006 retains one compact set for each whole interval [s,t], with 0<s and s<t; real endpoints are finite automatically. H002 only requires smoothness on domain={p | 0<p.2}, not across time zero. Extending a source map by q at nonpositive times gives an allowed total map, while restriction recovers every source map; locality preserves the positive-time hypotheses in both directions. All H inputs in worker signatures agree with their declared direct inputs; no internal T result becomes an external root. H003 is retained in P despite being unused by this route. The domain and assumptions are nonvacuous: for any positive dimensions and unit q, the constant map u=q satisfies them with empty support and scalar witness zero.
